note_do_not_run: This file assembles the CATALOG-SURFACING experiment input set only (three arms: baseline per-source virtual tools; Design 1 card-carried search_data_catalog + fetch_from_catalog; Design 2 discovery-expands-declaration). Per standing methodology (NATE-first, sign-off on inputs BEFORE any run) the experiment MUST NOT be executed until NATE signs this file. Unlike the model-free fetcher_fold_routing parity run, the headline metrics here (source-selection accuracy + param fidelity + one-retry) are MODEL-IN-THE-LOOP; only the GRADING is deterministic (fired/selected names vs the acceptable set; validate_params pass/fail). status flips when NATE signs.
surfacing_note: acceptable is the SAME source name in all three arms; only the LOCUS the grader reads differs. arm0 (baseline): the per-source virtual tool fired == acceptable[0]. arm1 (Design 1): the `source` argument passed to fetch_from_catalog == acceptable[0] (the model reaches it 2-hop: search_data_catalog -> fetch_from_catalog). arm2 (Design 2): the per-source tool DECLARED by the search-hit expansion AND then fired == acceptable[0]. Every phrasing is tagged origin=REUSED_SIGNED (carried verbatim from the SIGNED fetcher_fold_routing set, natealmanza 2026-07-29) or origin=SIGNED_NATE_2026-07-30 (NATE signs these).

validation.method: Every acceptable name below (14 source twin names + all control expected names) MUST be checked against the LIVE TOOL_REGISTRY at experiment load, exactly as experiments/fetcher_fold_routing/inputs/phrasings.json validation did (full surface import incl. workflows/solver/search). The 5 REUSED_SIGNED source names + the 12 REUSED_SIGNED control names already resolved True in the signed file (registry_size_at_check=200). The 9 SIGNED_NATE_2026-07-30 source names are the promoted spec twin names from the 14 fetchers/**/source.yaml specs; the 7 SIGNED_NATE_2026-07-30 distractor control names (run_sfincs, run_swmm, run_openquake, fetch_dem, run_openquake as door, fetch_naip, fetch_goes_active_fire, fetch_nws_alerts_conus) were grep-confirmed present in-tree during design and MUST be load-validated before sign-off.
